about: Every place the estate decided what words MEAN by matching them, from the word-matching audit of 23 Sep 2026 (class i: a decision about meaning that must become reasoning). founder_instruction 886-903: 'NO word matching anywhere'. 'migrated' = the meaning now comes from _shared/think.ts and its 'proof' is enforced by scripts/checks/decision_points_are_reasoned.test.mjs. 'pending' = still word-decided, in the order they will be migrated (customer-facing and money first). A regex that guards OUR outgoing text, or parses a format, is not listed: the ruling permits it.

points.held: Held: the visitor's reply is not touched (the assistant gives the public contact whenever a person is asked for); only the CEO's visibility report waits in the customer_support queue (dedupe widget:person:<ip>:<hour>), and reasoned_delivery files it when the replay reasons that a person was asked for. Nobody is reported on a regex.

points.decides: isGreeting/isMenuWord decide a message in the awaiting-problem state is not the problem
points.held: Held: no message is taken as a greeting on a word; it goes on to the other handlers, whose last word is the menu (reofferMenu), so nobody is unanswered. Nothing is queued: by the time the hold lifts the conversation has moved on (queueWhenHeld false).

points.decides: free text after 'Report a problem' becomes a case by flow state, not by what it says
points.held: Held: after "Report a problem" the words are kept as the support case all the same (a person reads them, the customer gets a reference; the turn records meaning=held); only a message REASONED to be a hello or something else is not filed. Not queued: the case itself carries the words.

points.decides: under the hold the intake no longer seeds its trade from detectCat/detectTrades: the trade is reasoned over every category, and while that is held the intake is HELD (status held, the customer told it is being reviewed) and reopened by fn_reason_held_resolve
KW map, tradeHits, detectCat, detectTrades, COMPONENT_OF (also customer_api create_inquiry fallback)
points.held: Held: no trade is read off words anywhere. The intake's trade is the stored one, the model's, or reasoned by tradeOf (held: the intake is held, point 18); the operational router (fn_kb_route_decide, alias matching) no longer decides it or asks from it. create_inquiry takes the intake's trade (point 20) and inbound_email reasons via tradeOfText (point 22). _shared/trade_classify.ts (KW, tradeHits, detectCat, detectTrades, COMPONENT_OF) is deleted.

points.decides: keyword trade reading on create_inquiry
points.held: Nothing to hold: create_inquiry posts only from a 'ready' intake, and inquiry_intake always saves its reasoned trade on it (the model's, tradeOf's — held, the intake itself is held and never reaches ready, point 18 — or 'general' for none). customer_api/keywords.ts (KW, detect) is deleted and create_inquiry reads no words for a trade.

points.decides: resolveTrade
points.held: Held: a typed word that is not itself a taxonomy code is not searched and is returned in `confirming` (why_empty trade_being_confirmed); nothing is queued because the answer is this live search, which the customer runs again (queueWhenHeld false). The alias and label-substring matches are deleted.

points.held: Held: the new lead is saved with no sector (nothing is guessed), the question waits in the sales engineer's queue (dedupe lead_sector:<lead id>), and fn_reason_apply_inbound_email__infer_sector sets the reasoned category_specs trade while the sector is still empty. The reasoning runs beside the intake (EdgeRuntime.waitUntil), never blocking it.

points.held: Held: no price band is offered on a guess (reason held); the visitor is still answered from the FAQ and the support corpus, and nothing is queued because a closed chat has no one to deliver a late price to.
